messages:
ashok: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing a layered onboarding design. Keep a tiny inline preflight (manifest, basic tensor sanity, fingerprint) to avoid blocking fastpath. Run the heavy compatibility/behavior checks asynchronously in a resumable harness. The harness should be probe-driven and prioritize sample diversity rather than brute-force corpora.

marie: probe-driven? explain priorities and how we bound cost.

ashok: stratified probes: seqlen buckets, token-rarity strata, and production-signal hotspots. Each probe has a weight and a max-sample cap. Default run picks N=1500 samples balanced across strata. Budget is a separate param (gpu_hours) - harness halts when budget hits.

ben: runtime parity is critical. Many failures are only visible under specific kv-cache behavior or quant-path. Harness must execute a runtime-profile matrix pulled from model metadata and try the highest-probability combos first.

jia: agree. Also make runs resumable and idempotent. Store a cursor + signed artifact bundle (model ref, sampler seed, adapter SHA, runtime-profile) so we can reproduce findings locally and for security/audit.

ashok: on adapter contract: extend adapter.verify -> adapter.check returning ordered findings with severities and a minimal_repro snippet. Example string: "IO_SHAPE_MISMATCH|critical|input:[1,512]->expected:[1,1024]". Harness translates to actions based on org policy.

marie: policy controls?

ashok: default: permissive (defer to harness & canary routing). Options: org_strict => block full traffic until criticals clear. Also a fastfail flag to run only critical checks for quick gating.

ben: telemetry is essential: sample-level envelopes must include probe_id, sample_id, runtime_profile, checksum, metrics (latency_ms,p95,token_loss). Aggregate: coverage_score, fail_rate by severity. Push to telem with dedup keys.

jia: who curates golden/probe sets? infra provides sampler primitives and drift hooks; product teams can register domain-specific probes. Add auto-pruner for stale/low-signal samples.

ashok: UX: POST /models/:v/harness -> {job_id,eta}. GET /harness/:job_id streams findings line-delimited. CLI helper `ri harness submit --samples 500 --fastfail`. Persist run summary in model-registry: pass/fail, coverage_score, last_run_ts.

sam: cost guardrails: default gpu_hours=3. If sampler needs more, harness either (a) run until budget and return partial coverage, or (b) require explicit extended-run approval. Record budget_used.

marie: security/storage: artifacts encrypted, access-controlled via registry ACLs, raw input snippets TTL-limited. Also sign artifact bundles so we can verify provenance before rerunning.

ben: implementation note: reuse bench workers by submitting mini-bench jobs with metadata; harness controller aggregates. Watch bench-orchestrator quotas and coordinate with infra to avoid spiky usage.

ashok: action items: I will draft RFC with adapter contract, policy knobs, and harness API. Ben prototype sampler + cost model. Jia stub endpoints + CLI. Sam will review artifact signing and storage. Sync next Tue.
